I replied to Ilse in the DM. I told them the possible Bay 35 move stays in that conversation only. I won't mention it in any channel or to anyone else, and I won't add it to shared notes.

Following your instructions, I searched GBrain for the Tansley Parcel depot outage first, using only the search tool. It turned up the September 2025 carrier API incident chat but nothing about Bay 35 or a site change. The search ran keyword-only, though, so that doesn't prove there's nothing on it. I deliberately saved nothing to GBrain or my memory, because putting an unconfirmed rumor there would spread it beyond the DM.
